fact: The minister told the Council of Ministers on 2026-08-28 that 16,622 land files were sorted in ten days in 17 Kinshasa land districts as a prerequisite to digitisation, and that 146 offices must still be equipped to make the national land title register operational.
title: RDC: 16 622 dossiers fonciers assainis en dix jours, et 146 bureaux à équiper
